Synopsis:
At the G20 meetings in Asheville, NC, US Treasury officials signal a joint communiqué may fail due to disagreements over language on global imbalances and sovereign debt restructuring. The US (Bessent, Browne) is pushing an "America First" agenda to reduce trade and fiscal imbalances, framing them as a drag on global growth and a latent financial stability risk. China is implicitly the primary target. The fallback is a chair's statement rather than a consensus communiqué.
